title: Algebra card lessons
intro: Short interactive lessons. Start anywhere: the highlighted lesson is the suggested next one.

what-is-a-variable.title: What is a variable?
what-is-a-variable.description: Year 7 card lesson on what a variable is, built around four things students move: a balance, a mat, a tile pattern and a number machine.

writing-expressions.title: Writing expressions
writing-expressions.description: Year 7 card lesson on writing expressions: an expression is a recipe for a number you do not know yet. Bags and marbles, think-of-a-number stories, brackets, less than, and a money context.

substitution.title: Substitution
substitution.description: Year 7 card lesson on substitution: put the number where the letter was, then follow the order of operations. A formula machine, the 3n-is-not-34 trap, AFL scores, weekly pay, rectangle area, two letters at once and working backwards.

equivalent-expressions.title: Equivalent expressions
equivalent-expressions.description: Year 7 card lesson on equivalent expressions: two machines on one slider show when expressions give the same number for every value of the variable.

properties-with-letters.title: Properties with letters
properties-with-letters.description: Year 7 card lesson: letters state a rule about all numbers at once. Commutative and associative properties of addition and multiplication, and counterexamples for subtraction and division.

one-step-equations.title: One-step equations
one-step-equations.description: Year 7 card lesson on one-step equations: an equation is a balance, whatever you do to one side you do to the other, and the solution is the number that makes it true.

two-step-equations.title: Two-step equations
two-step-equations.description: Year 7 card lesson on solving two-step equations on a balance: undo the loose marbles first, then share.

backtracking.title: Backtracking
backtracking.description: Year 7 card lesson on backtracking: find the input of a number machine by undoing each step in reverse order, then solve equations such as 3x + 7 = 19 and check by running forwards.

equations-from-stories.title: Equations from stories
equations-from-stories.description: Year 7 card lesson on writing equations from everyday money stories: name the unknown as a number, write the equation, solve it, then check the answer in the story.

growing-patterns.title: Growing patterns
growing-patterns.description: Year 7 card lesson on growing patterns: see the part that stays the same and the part that grows, then use a rule to find any step without drawing it.

tables-to-rules.title: Tables to rules
tables-to-rules.description: Year 7 card lesson on finding the rule that links each input in a table of values to its output, built around a hidden number machine, rule tiles and a small grid.

like-terms.title: Like terms
like-terms.description: Year 8 card lesson on like terms: you can only combine things of the same kind. Blue and purple bags of marbles, sliders and term sorting.

area-model-expansion.title: Expanding with the area model
area-model-expansion.description: Year 8 card lesson on expanding and factorising a(b + c) as the area of a rectangle split into two parts, built around an area model students drag.
